note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model architecture settings for UPerNet with a ConvNeXt backbone used by MMSegmentation.

review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization config dict used across decode and auxiliary heads
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor config dict with ImageNet mean/std normalization settings
review_backbone_config: review the mmpretrain ConvNeXt base backbone config with pretrained ImageNet checkpoint
review_decode_head_config: review the UPerHead decoder config with multi-scale FPN and PPM for 19 class segmentation
